findings.text: _manifest_cannot_be_read catches only OSError around path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), so a manifest whose bytes are not valid UTF-8 raises UnicodeDecodeError out of review_self_state and faults the sweep instead of leaving the run waiting as its comment promises.

The sentence says all three cited logs were measured after primary main was merged in, but the baseline suite is measured at revision b5444d24, the pre-merge base; only the after suite and the scoped gate are at d5de993c5e.
